full_citation: Christiansburg Garment Co. v. EEOC, 434 U.S. 412 (1978)
court: Supreme Court of the United States
doctrine_established: asymmetric fee standard — prevailing plaintiffs presumptively recover; prevailing defendants only if claim was frivolous
applied_to_1988: Hughes v. Rowe, 449 U.S. 5 (1980) (same standard applies under §1988(b))
